# Frederic Labadie

## Summary

Frederic Labadie is an Analytics Architect based in Amsterdam. He works across analytics architecture, product telemetry, analytics engineering, UX telemetry, marketing analytics, experimentation, AI workflow design, instrumentation, and stakeholder adoption.

He was most recently a full-time Analytics Architect at TELUS Digital (2024–2026) and is available immediately, with no notice period. He has EU work authorisation and does not require visa sponsorship.

## Site purpose

This portfolio is intended for direct review by recruiters, hiring managers, analytics leaders, product leaders, marketing technology teams, UX-adjacent teams, and AI/design tools. The site is public and indexable; role-specific microsites and archived cases are excluded from search via page-level metadata.

A sitemap is published at `/sitemap.xml`.

## Selected case themes

### Shadow IT / compatibility configurator

A consumer electronics retail engagement where a lifecycle segmentation model surfaced an anomaly: a cohort returning shortly after purchase to buy specific components. A Sense-Making-informed conversation with frontline staff revealed that the official system did not support an informal compatibility workflow. The client later shipped a compatibility configurator, now central to the business, with a second iteration planned for 2026.

### State-regulated retail BI enablement

A BigQuery, Dataform, and Looker Studio reporting infrastructure replaced recurring manual report pulls. The work included a structured three-session handoff so the client could maintain and extend the system independently. The reporting layer continued running independently after the delivery team rolled off.

### Mixed-methods home services research

A Stanley Steemer / national home services case combining GA4 telemetry, A/B testing, UserZoom, and Dervin-informed neutral questioning. The case demonstrates the distinction between locating a funnel issue quantitatively and diagnosing the user gap qualitatively.

### Lifecycle measurement sign-off prototype

A financial services brand's B2B lifecycle marketing measurement framework was rendered as a synthetic-data React and ECharts prototype so the client could review and sign off on every metric before the Tableau build. 207 metrics across seven dashboards, each with a worked methodology panel; per-metric votes export to a markdown sign-off matrix; nine build prerequisites were surfaced before any BI work started. The anonymised prototype is live at https://portfoliodashboard.fredericlabadie.com.

## Privacy and indexing preference

This site is public and open to search indexing. Core pages carry `index, follow` metadata and a canonical link; role-specific microsites and archived case pages carry `noindex, follow` and are omitted from the sitemap. AI/design tools are welcome to read the site when given a URL directly.
